articles.title_en: Optimal Fiscal and Monetary Policy with Distorting Taxes
articles.title_cn: 扭曲税收下的最优财政与货币政策
articles.abstract_en: When government debt pays a lower return than private assets, the reasoning in Friedman’s (1969) essay on the optimal quantity of money suggests that it would be optimal to expand the debt until its return matched that on private assets. When the only other source of revenue is a distorting tax, however, this is not generally true. In a perfect foresight model, a benevolent government that can make credible commitments chooses a large gap in returns initially and high distorting taxation in the distant future. The optimal path of taxation is time inconsistent, with ever-increasing temptation to abandon the path. (JEL E23, E43, E52, E62, H20, H61, H63)
articles.abstract_cn: 当政府债务的回报低于私人资产时，弗里德曼（1969）关于最优货币数量的论文中的推理表明，最优做法是扩大债务直至其回报与私人资产相匹配。然而，当唯一的其他收入来源是扭曲性税收时，这通常并不成立。在一个具有完美预见性的模型中，一个能够做出可信承诺的仁慈政府会选择在初期保持较大的回报差距，并在遥远的未来实施高扭曲性税收。最优税收路径是时间不一致的，且放弃该路径的诱惑不断增加。（JEL E23, E43, E52, E62, H20, H61, H63）

articles.title_en: Terms-of-Trade Shocks are Not All Alike
articles.title_cn: 贸易条件冲击并非千篇一律
articles.abstract_en: Terms of trade are an inaccurate empirical proxy for how fluctuations in international prices affect the economy. To capture the relevance of terms of trade fluctuations for the domestic business cycle, the role of export and import prices needs to be analyzed separately. Using a sample of developing economies, we find that the economy’s response to a positive export price shock does not mirror the response to a negative import price shock. (JEL E23, E32, E43, F14, F44, O11)
articles.abstract_cn: 贸易条件是国际价格波动影响经济的经验代理变量，但并不准确。为了捕捉贸易条件波动对国内商业周期的重要性，需要分别分析出口价格和进口价格的作用。利用发展中经济体的样本，我们发现经济对正向出口价格冲击的反应并不与对负向进口价格冲击的反应相对称。(JEL E23, E32, E43, F14, F44, O11)

articles.title_en: Does Unemployment Risk Affect Business Cycle Dynamics?
articles.title_cn: 失业风险是否影响经济周期动态？
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, I show that the decline in consumption during unemployment depends on both liquid and illiquid wealth; that unemployment predicts illiquid asset withdrawal, primarily when households have few liquid assets; and that increased idiosyncratic unemployment risk leads to a rise in saving overall, but also to a decline in investment in illiquid assets. Motivated by these new findings, I embed endogenous unemployment risk in a two-asset, heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian model. The model is consistent with the new evidence and suggests that aggregate shocks are amplified by a flight-to-liquidity when unemployment risk rises, particularly when monetary policy is constrained. (JEL E12, E21, E24, E52, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我展示了失业期间消费的下降既取决于流动性财富也取决于非流动性财富；失业预示着非流动性资产的提取，主要发生在家庭持有少量流动性资产时；以及个体特有的失业风险增加总体上导致储蓄上升，但也导致非流动性资产投资下降。基于这些新发现，我将内生失业风险嵌入一个双资产、异质性主体的新凯恩斯模型中。该模型与新证据一致，并表明当失业风险上升时，总冲击通过流动性逃逸被放大，尤其是在货币政策受限的情况下。（JEL E12, E21, E24, E52, G51）

articles.title_en: A Unified Model of Learning to Forecast
articles.title_cn: 一个统一的预测学习模型
articles.abstract_en: We propose a model of boundedly rational and heterogeneous expectations that unifies adaptive learning, k-level reasoning, and replicator dynamics. Level-0 forecasts evolve over time via adaptive learning. Agents revise over time their depth of reasoning in response to forecast errors, observed and counterfactual. The unified model makes sharp predictions for when and how quickly markets converge in Learning-to-Forecast Experiments, including novel predictions for individual and market behavior in response to announced events. We present experimental results that support these predictions. We apply our unified approach in the New Keynesian model to study forward guidance policy. (JEL D83, D84, E12, E31, E32, E71)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个有限理性和异质性预期的模型，该模型统一了适应性学习、k级推理和复制者动态。第0级预测通过适应性学习随时间演变。代理人根据预测误差（包括观察到的和反事实的）随时间修正其推理深度。该统一模型对学习预测实验中市场何时以及多快收敛做出了精确预测，包括对公告事件响应的个体和市场行为的新颖预测。我们提供了支持这些预测的实验结果。我们将统一方法应用于新凯恩斯模型中，以研究前瞻指引政策。（JEL D83, D84, E12, E31, E32, E71）

articles.title_en: Skill Remoteness and Post-Layoff Labor Market Outcomes
articles.title_cn: 技能遥远度与裁员后劳动力市场结果
articles.abstract_en: Local skill remoteness captures the dissimilarity between the skill profiles of a worker’s last job and other jobs in a local labor market. Higher skill remoteness at layoff is associated with persistently lower earnings after layoff, a higher probability of changing occupation, a lower probability of being reemployed at jobs with similar skill profiles, and a higher propensity to migrate. Jobs destroyed in recessions are also more skill remote than those lost in booms. The local skill remoteness of jobs is an empirically relevant factor to explain the severity and cyclicality of displaced workers’ earnings losses and reallocation patterns. (JEL E24, E32, J24, J31, J61, J63, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 本地技能遥远度衡量的是工人最后一份工作的技能概况与当地劳动力市场中其他工作之间的差异性。裁员时技能遥远度越高，与裁员后持续较低的 earnings、更高的职业转换概率、在技能概况相似的工作中再就业的概率较低以及更高的迁移倾向相关。经济衰退期间被摧毁的工作也比繁荣时期失去的工作更具技能遥远性。工作的本地技能遥远度是解释被置换工人收入损失和重新配置模式的严重性和周期性的一个经验相关因素。(JEL E24, E32, J24, J31, J61, J63, R23)

articles.title_en: Job Displacement and Earnings Losses: The Role of Joblessness
articles.title_cn: 工作流失与收入损失：失业的作用
articles.abstract_en: A large literature finds that workers displaced in mass layoffs experience persistent earnings losses. We find that the earnings penalty from job displacement is mediated by the length of the jobless spell after displacement. Workers who experience little or no joblessness suffer no losses on average; those who experience a prolonged period of joblessness experience large, persistent earnings losses. Job movers who experience joblessness tend to move to lower-paying firms, a phenomenon that informs our understanding of the mechanisms that generate earnings losses. We also find that jobless duration predicts earnings outcomes for separators generally, not only displaced workers. (JEL E24, J24, J31, J62, J63, J64)
articles.abstract_cn: 大量文献发现，在大规模裁员中失业的工人会经历持续的收入损失。我们发现，工作流失带来的收入惩罚受到失业后无工作期间长度的影响。经历很少或没有失业的工人平均没有损失；那些经历长期失业的工人则遭受巨大且持续的收入损失。经历失业的工作转换者倾向于转向薪酬较低的企业，这一现象有助于我们理解产生收入损失的机制。我们还发现，失业持续时间可以预测离职者的收入结果，而不仅仅是针对被裁员的工人。（JEL E24, J24, J31, J62, J63, J64）

articles.title_en: The Geography of Consumption and Local Economic Shocks: The Case of the Great Recession
articles.title_cn: 消费地理与地方经济冲击：以大衰退为例
articles.abstract_en: We estimate across-county spending flows between firms and consumers for every county in the United States, providing a new consumption link that has not been studied previously. We highlight the importance of this link by estimating the effect of changes in local housing wealth on consumption and employment from 2001 to 2019. We generally find that the effect from changes in housing wealth crosses borders to affect consumption and employment in a pattern consistent with our spending flows. However, we find potential consumers who reside outside the local commuting zone disproportionately affect local spending and employment during the Great Recession. (JEL E21, E24, E32, G51, R12, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估算了美国每个县企业与消费者之间的跨县支出流，提供了一种此前未被研究的新消费联系。我们通过估算2001年至2019年间地方住房财富变化对消费和就业的影响来强调这一联系的重要性。我们普遍发现，住房财富变化的影响跨越边界，以与我们支出流一致的模式影响消费和就业。然而，我们发现，居住在当地通勤区之外的潜在消费者在大衰退期间对地方支出和就业产生了不成比例的影响。（JEL E21, E24, E32, G51, R12, R23）

articles.title_cn: 公共流动性与金融危机
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the equilibrium effect of public liquidity on financial crises. Banks borrow from households via insured deposits and partially runnable debt and suffer endogenous funding withdrawals from households in crises. Holding public liquidity alleviates banks’ liquidity problems. In equilibrium, a larger public liquidity supply reduces crisis severity and expands bank lending but crowds bank deposits and increases bank vulnerability to real shocks. The model quantitatively explains 40 percent of Treasury liquidity premium variations. Counterfactual analyses reveal that QE1 significantly improves output, 20 times larger than QE3. However, QE policies raise bank fragility against nonfinancial shocks such as COVID-19. (JEL E23, E32, E44, E52, E58, G01, G21)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了公共流动性对金融危机的均衡效应。银行通过受保存款和部分可挤兑债务从家庭借款，并在危机中遭受家庭的内生资金提取。持有公共流动性缓解了银行的流动性问题。在均衡状态下，更大的公共流动性供给降低了危机严重性并扩大了银行贷款，但挤出了银行存款并增加了银行对实际冲击的脆弱性。该模型定量解释了国债流动性溢价变异的40%。反事实分析显示，QE1显著改善产出，其效果是QE3的20倍。然而，量化宽松政策增加了银行对非金融冲击（如COVID-19）的脆弱性。(JEL E23, E32, E44, E52, E58, G01, G21)

articles.title_en: Min(d)ing the President: A Text Analytic Approach to Measuring Tax News
articles.title_cn: 挖掘总统：衡量税收新闻的文本分析方法
articles.abstract_en: Economic agents react to signals about future tax policy changes. Consequently, estimating their macroeconomic effects requires identification of such signals. We propose a novel text analytic approach for transforming textual information into an economically meaningful time series. Using this method, we create a tax news measure from all publicly available postwar communications of US presidents. Our measure predicts the direction and size of future tax changes and contains signals not present in previously considered (narrative) measures of tax changes. We investigate the effects of tax news and find that, for long anticipation horizons, pre-implementation effects lead initially to contractions in output. (JEL D72, D82, E62, H20, H30)
articles.abstract_cn: 经济主体对未来税收政策变化的信号作出反应。因此，估计其宏观经济效应需要识别此类信号。我们提出了一种新颖的文本分析方法，将文本信息转化为具有经济意义的时间序列。利用该方法，我们从美国战后所有公开的总统通讯中构建了一个税收新闻指标。该指标能够预测未来税收变化的方向和规模，并包含以往（叙事性）税收变化指标中未出现的信号。我们研究了税收新闻的影响，发现对于较长的预期期限，实施前效应最初会导致产出收缩。（JEL D72, D82, E62, H20, H30）

articles.abstract_en: We investigate the impact of severe weather shocks on the US macroeconomy over the past 60 years. Using a nonlinear vector autoregressive model, we find robust evidence of time-varying effects. While negligible at the beginning of the sample, the impact becomes signifi-cant at the end, where an increase in the severe weather index reduces aggregate industrial production and consumption growth rates, and raises aggregate unemployment and inflation rates. The effects are persistent for up to 20 months. Our findings suggest limited adaptation to the increased severity of weather in the United States, at least at the macroeconomic level. (JEL E21, E23, E24, E31, Q54)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了过去60年间恶劣天气冲击对美国宏观经济的影响。使用非线性向量自回归模型，我们发现了时变效应的稳健证据。虽然在样本初期影响微乎其微，但在样本末期影响变得显著，恶劣天气指数的上升降低了总体工业生产和消费增长率，并提高了总体失业率和通货膨胀率。这些效应持续长达20个月。我们的研究结果表明，美国对日益严重的天气状况的适应有限，至少在宏观经济层面是如此。（JEL E21, E23, E24, E31, Q54）
